name: Instacart MCP
description: Creates Instacart recipe pages and grocery shopping lists from your AI agent through the Instacart Developer Platform MCP, for developers with an API key.

skills.name: Create Recipe Page
skills.description: Creates an Instacart recipe page with ingredients, instructions and measurements through the create-recipe tool.

skills.name: Create Shopping List
